notes: Two Tones is a single-file, strictly greyscale interactive atlas of dithering. It renders procedural sphere, ramp and relief sources on canvas through four 1-bit methods (threshold, Bayer ordered, Floyd–Steinberg, Atkinson), and includes a live studio, a pointer-driven hero light, an orbit toggle, PNG export, scroll progress and reduced-motion support. It uses no external files, fonts or libraries. Limitation: verified with static checks and a stubbed-DOM run only, not in a real browser, so visual layout and motion are untested; browsers without :has() show the selected-state styling less clearly.
